thesis: Essential information must survive differences in color perception; check lightness and additional cues, then use grayscale to inspect foreground/background visual hierarchy.

reference.visualReviewScope: Entire reference sampled at5s(D25)/8s(D26), with English burned captions and relevant exact stills read. Not a claim of human playback/listening.

referenceMap.retainedTeachingPoint: Color-dependent puzzle information can become inaccessible; omit creator biography while preserving the design problem.
Art/theme changes alter the combinations that must remain distinguishable.
Use color-vision simulations, including Protanopia-type and Deuteranopia-type views.
Increase useful lightness differences without merging objects into the background; reinforce with distinct patterns.
Apply the same consideration to power-ups and interactive stage objects.
Grayscale reveals the hierarchy of light/dark: a distant background must not overpower the relevant foreground.
Like horizontally flipping artwork, removing color can reveal problems hidden by familiarity.

sourceCorrections.issue: Automatic captions misrecognize the final background example as circle/gold.
sourceCorrections.resolution: Viewed the actual English burned captions and images: distant background should not be more prominent than foreground.
Actual source screen shows Color Blindness–Protanopia-type and Deuteranopia-type; verified official Adobe names.

omissions.item: Creator introduction, personal production history/delegation, loading music, end slate
omissions.reason: Noninstructional creator framing omitted; no experience attributed to us.

addedExplanation: Four-connected-Puyo prerequisite beside the opening actual game example.
One-variable color-loss illustration, then contrast against background and redundant shape/pattern cues.
Actual2021 PPT2 color-adjustment options, verified against SEGA product update.
Different purposes of CVD simulation and grayscale; complement simulated views with diverse player experience.

games.title: Puyo Puyo Tetris 2
games.role: Color-dependent matching rule; inspect varied backgrounds and reinforce color with another clue.
games.equivalence: Replaces Meteos in the same teaching role: the player must distinguish matching types while puzzle objects and backgrounds coexist. Puyo uses four connected Puyos, not Meteos launches.
games.beginnerRules: Concentrate on the left Puyo field; move/rotate a falling pair and connect at least four of one color. Exclude dialogue and use pure Puyo rounds where possible.
games.versionReason: 2020 game with verified2021 color-adjustment update. New2S edition does not change the selected four-connect teaching role; retain the independently inspectable FHD recording.

rights.recorderPermission: Both GATA TV sources explicitly carry Creative Commons Attribution license (reuse allowed) in their current YouTube metadata.
rights.requiredDescriptionCredit: ©SEGA Tetris ® ＆ © 1985～2020 Tetris Holding. Recording: GATA TV, original URLs, Creative Commons Attribution (reuse allowed).
rights.conditions: Own educational commentary, fair portrayal, source attribution; no story/dialogue excerpts and no standalone music release.
rights.sourceAudio: Preserve synchronized game audio for selected gameplay; do not select story/dialogue or external commentary. No external narrator in the recorder-described SANS COMMENTAIRE captures.

games.title: Super Mario Bros. Wonder
games.role: Flower versus question-mark block recognition, visible interaction/result and foreground/background hierarchy.
games.equivalence: Concrete interactive objects replace generic power-up/stage-mechanism examples; ordinary and Wonder states make the background hierarchy observable without a reference-lesson clip.
games.beginnerRules: Mario runs/jumps on solid foreground paths, hits blocks and touches flowers. A Wonder Flower visibly changes the scene.
games.versionReason: Original2023 product-page captures demonstrate the same object/visual hierarchy mechanics; Switch2 additions are not claimed.

rights.recordingProvenance: Direct non-narrated1920x1080 MP4s linked by the official product page, not a Nintendo Direct or stage demo.
rights.sourceAudio: Keep actual synchronized game mix under narration; content remains original educational commentary, not a standalone music/video reupload.

sources.finalSelectedWindows: Not adopted in final actual cut list; preserved as research/source alternative.

nintendoExampleCount.reason: Two smallest sufficient concept-matched games; round2/3 to one Nintendo example. Game variants/cuts are not additional examples.
